thread:
Maya Patel: customer hit a 400 on POST /v1/rerank around 09:12 UTC. they pasted the request body and the API returned `400 Bad Request` with a short message: "Invalid request: candidates must be a non-empty array". they say this started after a UI filter change. attaching their payload below.

Ken Zhao: can you paste the raw request body and headers? also which client/library are they using?

Maya Patel: they said they're using a Rust backend (actix-web) that forwards user selections to us. headers: `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>`, `Content-Type: application/json`. raw body they sent: ```json
{"queries": ["find restaurants near me"], "candidates": [], "top_k": 5, "id": "session_abc"}
```

Priya Nair: aha — `candidates` is an empty array. our schema requires candidates to be a non-empty array of candidate objects with `id` and `text` (or `content`). many UI filters can drop all candidates and still send an empty list. Does the customer expect us to handle empty candidates by returning empty ranking?

Maya Patel: customer says they expected an empty ranking (200 + empty result) but suddenly our API rejects that. their logs show we return 400 with message above.

Samir Gupta: our current contract for /v1/rerank expects at least one candidate. We return 400 on validation to avoid wasting compute and avoid ambiguous scores. That said, we should help them workaround. Quick repro: I ran a curl against staging with the same body and got the same 400 and payload error. Staging response: `{\"error\":\"Invalid request: candidates must be a non-empty array\"}`

Maya Patel: customer wants either (a) guidance to change frontend to not call rerank when no candidates, or (b) we accept empty array and respond with empty ranked list. Which do we recommend?

Ken Zhao: recommend frontend changes as the immediate fix. We should also document this in the API errors page. But short-term, give them a guard: if candidates.length == 0 -> skip call.

Priya Nair: also check they aren't accidentally serializing candidate objects as strings. Example of correct candidate: ```json
{"candidates": [{"id":"c1","text":"Pizza place"}, {"id":"c2","text":"Sushi"}] }
``` Incorrect: ```json
{"candidates": ["{\"id\":\"c1\",\"text\":\"Pizza\"}"] } // stringified object
``` The latter will pass basic JSON parse but fail schema/type checks.

Maya Patel: customer payload above is empty array, not stringified. They said a recent client change filters duplicates out and sometimes leaves zero.

Samir Gupta: note on our side: logs include a validation stack trace (truncated): ```
ValidationError: candidates: must be non-empty array
 at validateRequest (/srv/rerank/service/validate.rs:128)
 at handler (/srv/rerank/service/handler.rs:44)
```

support-bot: incident note added — ticket #CS-5273 linked. :spiral_note_pad:

Priya Nair: Suggested response to customer (copy): 
1) quick fix: update your client to skip calling /v1/rerank when candidates array is empty. Example pseudo: `if (candidates.length === 0) return [];`
2) alternative: wrap call and accept 400 by returning empty result on your side. Not ideal.
3) long-term: we can consider changing the API to accept empty arrays and return 200+empty list, but this would be a behavioral change. I'll open an RFC.

Maya Patel: customer asks for a minimal example curl to test locally — can we paste one?

Ken Zhao: sure — minimal failing example (expected 400):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"queries": ["q"], "candidates": [], "top_k": 3}'
```
Correct example that returns 200: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"queries": ["q"], "candidates": [{"id":"a","text":"alpha"}], "top_k": 3}'
```

Samir Gupta: added a short snippet to support KB to show both server error and sample fix. Filing a docs edit: DOCS-142.

Maya Patel: customer asked if auth could be related — they see 400 not 401/403, so not an auth issue. billing? also not likely.

Priya Nair: follow-up QA question: does the client ever send `null` for candidates? we treat `null` the same as missing -> 400. If they send `"candidates": null` they'll get `Invalid request: candidates must be an array`.

Maya Patel: customer confirmed they will change their code to skip the request. they pushed a tiny patch to check length before POST and will redeploy.

Samir Gupta: dev note — we might be able to map empty candidates -> 200 empty response behind a feature flag for compatibility. I'll prototype but low pri.

Oncall Bot: checklists updated, escalation resolved? :white_check_mark:

Maya Patel: closing loop with customer now, pasted these instructions and the curl. will update ticket once they redeploy. thanks everyone! :slightly_smiling_face:
